Its large hood/head, tucked feet and tiny hands already read as a baby; seated leaf interaction and small left-side scale work. Enlargement or a taller body would weaken the scene hierarchy.
mustFix: Do not return to 08 hollow Muse eyes; retain the repaired solid dark eyes.
Grok still has visible dark/grey inner eye marks in the inspected crop. Apply the owner-requested clean white ovals without inner dots, retaining their current footprint.
optional: One localized comparison may soften the hood seam/rim contrast and make the existing face opening subtly more rounded-square within the same outer silhouette. Keep warm cream, restrained matte textile and tiny dark eyes; do not add conspicuous fur or enlarge the face.
rerenderRisk: A full-scene rerender is disproportionate. Even a local repair may change eye spacing, hands, leaf contact or Grok; accept only a visibly stronger likeness at actual banner size with the original moths and four-guest staging preserved.
